headlines.description: — Morgan Barron scored the tiebreaking goal late in the second period, Nico Daws made 21 saves and the Winnipeg Jets added to their surge with a 4-2 victory over the Boston Bruins on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Barron scores go-ahead goal as Jets keep rolling with 4-2 victory over Bruins

events.name: New York Rangers at Buffalo Sabres

headlines.description: — Rasmus Dahlin, Zach Benson and Jiri Kulich each had a goal and an assist to lead the Buffalo Sabres to a 5-1 win over the New York Rangers on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dahlin scores 17 seconds into the game and the Sabres go on to a 5-1 win over the Rangers

events.name: Carolina Hurricanes at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Eric Robinson and Jaccob Slavin scored third-period goals 1:37 apart, Brandon Bussi stopped 32 shots and the Carolina Hurricanes rallied to beat the Tampa Bay Lightning 3-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eric Robinson and Jaccob Slavin score in 3rd period to help Hurricanes rally past Lightning 3-1

headlines.description: — Brad Marchand and Aleksander Barkov returned to the Florida lineup in style, with Marchand getting three assists and Barkov...
headlines.shortLinkText: Marchand has 3 assists, Barkov scores in return and Panthers beat Senators 5-3

events.name: St. Louis Blues at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Bo Horvat scored the deciding goal in the shootout, and the New York Islanders rallied to beat the St. Louis Blues 3-2 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Islanders rally late, beat Blues 3-2 in shootout

headlines.description: — Joel Farabee had a goal and an assist and the Calgary Flames beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 6-3 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Farabee has a goal and an assist to help the Flames beat the Penguins 6-3

headlines.description: — Alex Tuch scored his team-leading 15th goal and had two assists, and the Washington Capitals scored four times inside the final three minutes of a 7-3 victory over the Philadelphia Flyers on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alex Tuch leads Capitals with a goal and 2 assists in 7-3 win over Flyers

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Arseny Gritsyuk scored in a shootout and New Jersey Devils beat Columbus 3-2 on Wednesday night, topping the Blue Jackets for the second time in three days and sending them to their fourth consecutive home loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gritsyuk scores in shootout as Devils beat Blue Jackets 3-2

events.name: Vancouver Canucks at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Emmitt Finnie scored two early goals to lead the Detroit Red Wings to a 5-1 victory over the Vancouver Canucks on Wednesday night in a battle of last-place teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Finnie, Arvidsson each have 3 points in Red Wings' 5-1 win over Canucks

headlines.description: — Mavrick Bourque scored his first goal for Nashville, getting it against the team that traded him nearly five months ago as the Predators beat Dallas 3-1 on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Mavrik Bourque returns to Dallas and scores his first goal for Nashville in 3-1 win

headlines.description: — Logan Cooley and Dylan Guenther each had a goal and an assist for the Utah Mammoth in a 4-3 win over the Minnesota Wild on Wednesday night. It was the first regulation loss for Minnesota in 16 games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mammoth's 4-3 win gives the Wild their first regulation loss in 16 games to end a franchise-best run

headlines.description: — Devon Toews scored twice in a 1:33 span during the second period, Mackenzie Blackwood stopped 28 shots and the refreshed Colorado Avalanche beat the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Toews scores 2 quick goals in 2nd period, Blackwood sharp in net as Avalanche beat Canadiens 6-0

headlines.description: — Roman Kantserov scored two goals, pushing his team-leading total 15, and the Chicago Blackhawks beat the Seattle Kraken 3-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Roman Kantserov scores 2 as the Blackhawks beat the Kraken 3-1, sweep road trip

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Anaheim Ducks

headlines.description: — Cutter Gauthier scored his 23rd goal of the season to tie for the NHL lead, Laurent Brossoit made 22 saves and the Anaheim Ducks routed the San Jose Sharks 7-0 on Wednesday night to end a four-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cutter Gauthier scores again to help the Ducks rout the Sharks 7-0
